headline: Production Planner

experience.title: Production Planner
experience.employer: Lanao del Sur Halal Food Manufacturing Inc.
bullets: Build weekly production schedules for three lines making halal sausages and canned goods.
Track daily output against plan and adjust schedules when orders or supplies change.
Plan materials with the inventory team and flag shortages to purchasing a week ahead.
Helped plan the layout and staffing of a new canning line.
Analyse planned versus actual output in Excel and present it at the monthly review.

experience.title: Production Clerk
bullets: Recorded production output and downtime for two lines.

summary: Production planner with four years in halal food manufacturing in Lanao del Sur and Cotabato City. I schedule production across lines, monitor output against plan, help set up new lines and products, and plan materials with inventory and purchasing. I use data to keep plans realistic.
